I flipped open the leather photograph and did my Kendall Hale voice—'set it on VIBRATE, honey'—winking at Remy Hollis like I was handing him the keys to the kingdom. His face? Priceless.
I saw that look in Remy Hollis’s eyes—the dumb, dreamy kind—and I started yelling 'Danger, Will Robinson, danger' to stop him. He didn’t listen. He just walked away.

I cranked up the rock music just to see Remy Hollis freak out—he told me not to touch anything, but come on, what’s a limo without a soundtrack?
I popped the Dom Perignon and got drenched in champagne—foam everywhere, right down my pants—and yeah, it was messy, but damn, did it feel like we’d stolen the good life for a minute.
I stuck my head out of the limo sunroof, wind blasting my face, and yelled, 'This is how the other half lives, bro—enjoy it while you can,' while Remy Hollis looked like he might puke or pass out.
